reader_notes: Reads as a genuine Swedish op-ed: first-person stance, concessions ("Jag medger gärna..."), and a closing turn ("kostnaden dyker upp någon annanstans"). Register is consistent with the byline "transportforskare och debattör".

Q2 depends on the reader separating the author's thesis (A) from the cited council's caution (C), which the text does keep clearly apart ("Rådets egen försiktighet är rimlig, men den bör inte förväxlas med ett underkännande"). Defensible, but it is the one place a hurried reader could slip.
